qualifier: phosphatidylcholine and phosphatidylglycerol, not cardiolipin or PA/DAG/TAG
name: Phosphatidylcholine and phosphatidylglycerol synthesis via CDP intermediates
rationale: All members concern CDP-choline or CDP-diacylglycerol routes to PC and PG (including PG remodeling), distinguishing the theme from PA/DAG/TAG-synthesis and cardiolipin confusables.

qualifier: in asymmetric division of neural progenitors
name: Spindle and centrosome positioning in neural progenitor asymmetric division
rationale: Members cover spindle orientation, astral microtubules and centrosome localization together with forebrain neuroblast/progenitor division and stem cell maintenance, which the centriole/microtubule-nucleation confusables lack.

core: rRNA transcription and early pre-rRNA processing
qualifier: Pol I elongation/termination and ETS/ITS endonucleolytic cleavage
name: rRNA transcription elongation, termination and early pre-rRNA cleavage
rationale: Members span Pol I elongation/termination, 5S rRNA transcription by Pol III and early 5'-ETS/ITS1/ITS2 cleavages, unlike confusables centred on Pol I initiation and chromatin control, Pol III elongation or MYC-driven ribosome assembly.

name: Purine salvage and PRPP synthesis
rationale: All members concern recycling purine bases/nucleosides via APRT/HPRT and supplying PRPP, distinct from purine catabolism and de novo purine synthesis confusables.

qualifier: controlling sleep, stress and innate behaviors
name: Neuropeptide signaling controlling sleep, stress and innate behaviors
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/opioid/orexin GPCR signaling with sleep-wake, stress, mating, parental, aggression and ingestive behaviors, versus confusables on drug reward, HPA hormone secretion or feeding alone.

core: Cellular response to heavy metal ions
qualifier: heme oxygenase-linked oxidative stress rather than metallothionein or iron homeostasis
name: Heme oxygenase-linked oxidative response to heavy metal ions
rationale: Members are responses to lead, mercury, cobalt, selenium and iron(II) plus HMOX1 and peroxide control, distinguishing them from MTF1/metallothionein and iron-transport confusables.

name: Nucleotide sugar transport and UDP-glucuronate formation
rationale: All three members provide activated UDP-sugars (UDP-GlcNAc transport, nucleotide sugar transport, UDP-glucuronate formation), unlike confusables on SLC35 disease, PAPS, N-glycan processing or UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis.

core: Iron and heme uptake and transport
name: Iron and heme uptake with scavenger receptor plasma clearance
rationale: Members cover transferrin/ferroportin/heme iron handling plus class A/B/F/H scavenger receptors and immune complex clearance, which the copper/manganese, oxygen-transport and metal-detox confusables lack.

qualifier: anteroposterior and hindbrain segmental, with neural border/crest
name: Anteroposterior neural plate and hindbrain segmental patterning
rationale: Members cover anterior/posterior neural plate, neural plate border and crest, rhombomeres, midbrain-hindbrain boundary and anterior HOX activation, distinguishing them from dorsoventral and axial mesoderm confusables.

qualifier: Fas/TRAIL signaling and T cell deletion
name: Fas/TRAIL death receptor apoptosis and T cell deletion
rationale: Members concern Fas/TRAIL/TNF death receptor apoptosis, BID activation and activation-induced T cell and thymocyte death, unlike confusables centred on caspase-8/c-FLIP control and necroptosis.

name: TGF-beta–SMAD2/3 signaling with cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets
rationale: Members cover TGF-beta receptor/SMAD signaling and its regulation including TGFBR/SMAD cancer mutants and RUNX3 targets, versus Hippo/YAP and activin confusables.

qualifier: FGFR2 downstream cascades and activated FGFR1/2/4 mutants
name: FGFR2 downstream cascades and activated FGFR1/2/4 point mutants
rationale: Members are FGFR2 FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and activating FGFR1/2/4 mutants, distinct from ligand-binding, FGFR3 and FGFR1-cascade confusables.

name: Cellular senescence with Polycomb heterochromatin silencing and SASP
rationale: Members span replicative, stress and oncogene-induced senescence with SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin, Polycomb (BMI1) modules and SASP, which the oncogene/oxidative-stress and p53 confusables lack.

name: MHC class I cross-presentation of exogenous antigens
rationale: All members describe endosomal or phagosomal routes presenting exogenous antigen on MHC class I, distinct from endogenous class I loading and class II confusables.

qualifier: receptor control of T, NK and dendritic cell activation
name: Immunoregulatory receptor control of T, NK and dendritic cell activation
rationale: Members regulate T cell costimulation, NK activation and dendritic cell differentiation via lymphoid–non-lymphoid receptor interactions, versus tolerance/Treg, KIR and resting-DC confusables.

name: BDNF–TrkB neurotrophin receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern BDNF/NTRK2 signaling and its downstream effectors, distinct from dendritic actin remodeling and NGF/CREB confusables.

core: Steroid and vitamin D hormone metabolism
name: Steroidogenesis, vitamin D metabolism and phosphate–mineral homeostasis
rationale: Members combine CYP-driven adrenal/gonadal steroidogenesis and vitamin D metabolism with SLC34/FGF23-Klotho/PTH phosphate handling and tooth/bone mineralization, versus retinoid/vitamin K, thyroid and mineralization-only confusables.

name: Estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: All three members concern estrogen or progesterone receptor signaling, distinct from mammary, thyroid and androgen receptor confusables.

name: Cytoplasmic mRNA translation initiation and elongation
rationale: Members cover 43S/eIF3 assembly, scanning, 60S joining and peptide elongation, distinct from termination/NMD, ribosome biogenesis and elongation-factor modification confusables.

qualifier: neurexin–neuroligin, PSD-95 and NMDA receptor clustering
name: Neurexin–neuroligin organization of excitatory glutamatergic synapses
rationale: Members cover neurexin/neuroligin, PSD-95 and NMDA receptor clustering and EPSP regulation, versus inhibitory synapse and PTPR/SALM adhesion confusables.

name: Th2 cytokine and eosinophil-driven type 2 immunity
rationale: Members center on Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13/33 signaling, eosinophil and mast cell responses and IgE switching, versus broad cytokine, FcεRI degranulation and Th17/IL-10 confusables.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride storage, lipophagy and LXR regulation
rationale: Members cover lipid droplet organization, lipophagy and triglyceride storage with LXR (NR1H2/3) transcriptional control, which the TAG-synthesis, lipolysis and adipogenesis confusables lack.

qualifier: PD-L1 turnover and HIV Nef/Vpu removal of CD4, CD8, CD28, MHC-I
name: Immune evasion via degradation of PD-L1, CD4 and MHC-I
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin/proteasome or lysosomal removal of immune surface proteins (PD-L1 regulation, Nef/Vpu targets), versus proteasome assembly and antigen-presentation confusables.

name: Regulation of PDGF receptor signaling
rationale: All three members are positive, negative or general regulation of PDGF receptor signaling, distinct from fibroblast/EMT and generic PI3K/ERK confusables.

name: Locomotor and motor coordination behavior
rationale: Members are walking, swimming, righting, grooming, exploration and psychomotor behaviors with Purkinje layer/amygdala development, versus social/vocal sensory behavior and synaptic transmission confusables.
